title: Replace missing values in an atomic vector.

origin.description: This infix function is similar to %||% but is vectorised and provides a default value for missing elements. It is faster than using base::ifelse() and does not perform type conversions.

arguments.name: y
arguments.description: The replacement values. Must be of length 1 or the same length as x.

origin.details: This infix function is similar to %||% but is vectorised and provides a default value for missing elements. It is faster than using base::ifelse() and does not perform type conversions.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(rlang))
cat(paste(c("a", "b", NA, "c") %|% "default", collapse = ","), "\n")
cat(paste(c(1L, NA, 3L, NA, NA) %|% (6L:10L), collapse = ","), "\n")

translation.description: Replace missing elements of an atomic vector without changing types.

arguments.name: x, y
arguments.description: An atomic vector and replacement values of the same type, with length 1 or the length of x.

translation.details: Replace missing elements of an atomic vector without changing types.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from rlang.na_or import Character, Integer, NA, na_or
left = na_or(Character(["a", "b", NA, "c"]), "default")
right = na_or(Integer([1, NA, 3, NA, NA]), Integer([6, 7, 8, 9, 10]))
print(",".join(str(item) for item in left.values))
print(",".join(str(item) for item in right.values))
